# 3 Masterpiece Patronage, Royal Art Treasury Curation & World Heritage Guardianship Decisions.
# Strictly compliant with EU5 1.4.9 DECISIONFMT (option = { name = ... effect = { ... } }) and DEC-LOC (.title/.desc).

# 1. Cross-Border Patronage of a Master Artist (15-year cooldown via oe_mst_patronage_cooldown_mod)
oe_mst_patronize_master = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_economic_canals
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_mst_has_patronage_base = yes
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mst_patronage_ready_tt
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_mst_patronage_cooldown_mod }
		}
		at_war = no
		gold >= 180
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	option = {
		name = oe_mst_patronize_master.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -180
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_mst_patronage_cooldown_mod
				years = 15
				mode = replace
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mst.13
		}
	}
}

# 2. Catalogue and Restore the Royal Art Treasury (10-year cooldown via oe_mst_treasury_catalogued_mod)
oe_mst_catalogue_treasury = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_economic_canals
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_works_of_art >= 1
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mst_treasury_ready_tt
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_mst_treasury_catalogued_mod }
		}
		gold >= 100
		any_work_of_art_in_country = {
			art_quality < 98
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	option = {
		name = oe_mst_catalogue_treasury.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -100
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_mst_treasury_catalogued_mod
				years = 10
				mode = replace
			}
			oe_mst_catalogue_treasury_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

# 3. Consecrate & Renew Owned Zero-DLC World Heritage Sites (D015/D017 Pure Location Soft Linkage)
oe_mst_consecrate_world_heritage = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_economic_canals
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_mst_owns_any_world_heritage_site = yes
	}
	allow = {
		at_war = no
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_mst_has_unconsecrated_heritage_tt
			oe_mst_has_unconsecrated_heritage_site = yes
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	option = {
		name = oe_mst_consecrate_world_heritage.a
		effect = {
			oe_mst_yearly_heritage_check = yes
		}
	}
}
